rules.title: How to play
rules.goal: Each round, predict exactly how many tricks you will take. A correct prophecy scores; a wrong one costs. Most points after the last round wins.
rules.deck: 60 cards: four suits (Sun, Moon, Star, Comet) numbered 1 to 13, plus 4 Archmages and 4 Fools.
rules.deal: Round 1 deals one card each, round 2 two cards, and so on, until the deck is used up (20 rounds with 3 players, 15 with 4, 12 with 5, 10 with 6). The deal moves one seat clockwise each round.
rules.trump: After dealing, the next card is turned up. Its suit is trump. A Fool, or no card left in the last round, means no trump. An Archmage lets the dealer choose the trump suit.
rules.bidding: Starting left of the dealer, everyone says how many tricks they will take, from 0 up to the number of cards in hand.
rules.play: The player left of the dealer leads the first trick; the winner of a trick leads the next. You must follow the suit led if you can. Archmages and Fools may always be played. If a Fool is led, the next number card sets the suit. If an Archmage is led, anything may follow.
rules.winning: The first Archmage played. Otherwise the highest trump. Otherwise the highest card of the suit led. If only Fools were played, the first Fool.
rules.scoring: Correct prophecy: 20 points plus 10 per trick taken. Wrong prophecy: minus 10 points for each trick you are off, either way.
